items.raw_excerpt: Kakkadampoyil plans a comprehensive tourism master plan to boost local economy and promote eco-friendly travel by November.

items.raw_excerpt: En esta edición de Ojos que Sí Ven en Cooperativa hablamos sobre el microemprendimiento femenino junto con Karina Gómez, directora ejecutiva de la organización de desarrollo social Fondo Esperanza, pionera en implementar en Chile un servicio financiero integral enfocado en los sectores vulnerables.
items.summary_en: A Chilean radio program featured a discussion on female micro-entrepreneurship with the director of Fondo Esperanza. The organization provides financial services to vulnerable communities across Chile. The show explored how women-led small businesses are growing in the country.

items.raw_excerpt: Maharashtra government meets tribal students' demands, urging them to end the hunger strike for better recruitment and school conditions.

items.raw_excerpt: Two women have become the first same-sex couple to marry in Bolivia following a four-year legal battle.

items.raw_excerpt: Six months ago, a young dog was dumped at Canil de Portimão in the cat colony outside, with a huge lump on his neck and no one to explain why he’d been left behind.
items.summary_en: A young dog named Benny was found abandoned outside Portimão's municipal shelter in Portugal. He arrived with a large lump on his neck, but no one could explain why he had been left behind. Shelter staff are now caring for him.

items.raw_excerpt: Two-time Paralympic champion Danielle Dorris of Moncton, N.B., earned Canada's first medal to open the three-day Pan Pacific Swimming Championships, grabbing silver in the women's 50-metre butterfly S5-7 final on Friday night in Walnut, Calif.

items.summary_en: A small town library in Kirkwood was recognized for its leadership in digital innovation. It won a national award for empowering its community. The library now sets a standard for other small libraries.

items.raw_excerpt: Cachorro, batizado de Cabo Caramelo, recebeu colete de identificação e agora faz 'patrulha' pelas ruas do Bairro do Recife. 'Fiel companheiro', diz comandante.
items.summary_en: A stray dog named Cabo Caramelo was adopted by a police battalion in Recife, Brazil. The dog now wears an identification vest and patrols the streets alongside officers. The battalion commander calls him a faithful companion.

items.raw_excerpt: Experience the vibrant spirit of Chennai at The Hindu's Made of Chennai festival, celebrating 387 years of culture through music and food.
